dedupe_keys.name: france sia aeronautical information aip france and airspace data

description: The Service de l'Information Aéronautique of France's civil aviation authority publishes the country's aeronautical information: the AIP France with its amendment cycles, an online AIP viewer and data sets such as ENR 5.4; its news of September 2026 notes that the ENR 5.4 data set for cycle 10/26 could not be produced after the Gironde wildfires. A copy on data.gouv.fr, posted by a third party, holds the SIA airspace exports in two formats: an XML export for SIA-specific applications and an AIXM 4.5 export following the Eurocontrol model, renewed every four weeks with the effective date in the file name; that copy was last updated in January 2020 and is under the Licence Ouverte 2.0. Coverage is national, including overseas territories in the exports' naming. Access: the SIA website offers the viewer and a shop for publications, whose conditions reserve commercial resale to contracts with SIA. Caveats: for navigation only current data may be used, the data.gouv.fr copy is out of date, and the licence of the official downloads was not found on the pages read. The airspace data support air traffic network and capacity models and hazard exposure studies of airspace closures. They complement the DGAC traffic series and the EUROCONTROL Aviation Intelligence Portal catalogued here.
